Substantive bridge, funnel and gallery faces shared by CPU/rendering. Small ladders, doors, optics, boat fittings and open lattice remain visual detail, not separate damage modules. Dated fit and source limitations retained.
Physical faceted protection replaces blanket boxes; nominal hull/structure steel is a gameplay estimate. Neither successful export nor plate labels certify a historical armor schedule.

Lower propellant stores and separate shell rooms above follow O-45 section order. Four turbine and twelve boiler-room envelopes follow S-06-2 arrangement; precise boundaries, capacity and mass are estimates. Stable original module IDs remain; added engine IDs distinguish the after pair.

review.title: Yamato · fidelity 01
review.intro: Matched pre-pass and current exported geometry, documented dimensions, structural probes and historical evidence. Both authored stages use the same twelve fixed cameras.
review.limits: No historical accuracy percentage. Exact offsets, many fitting locations, nominal plating and internal room boundaries remain approximations. See discrepancies.md and the source register. Raster overlays use one uniform scale per source sheet; unresolved source/datum mismatch remains visible.
